messages:
Anna (Design): quick poll 1: compact legend with abbrev units vs expanded legend with full units for the metrics dashboard? i pushed two mocks.
Raj (Eng-Frontend): compact saves horizontal space but new users lose context. responsive swap could work.
Milo (DataViz): i like full units on desktop, abbrev on narrow view. shared y-scale by default for rows with multiple series.
Priya (Accessibility): ensure abbreviations have full aria-labels (e.g., aria-label=\"Latency (milliseconds)\"). legends need 48px touch targets and clear focus states.
Zoe (PM): default should be readable for the majority: full units desktop, abbrev on mobile. surface a control to switch.
Anna (Design): proposal: Legend header: \"Units: Full | Abbrev\" pill. tooltip: \"Abbrev saves space; hover to reveal full unit.\" default = Full on desktop.
Raj (Eng-Frontend): implementation note: add data attrs fullUnit/shortUnit to legend items. pill must be keyboard operable; support Enter/Space.
Milo (DataViz): smoothing: per-series smoothing preferred. indicate smoothed series with a micro-chip in the legend and dashed stroke.
Anna (Design): legend item layout: [swatch] Name 1 unit 1 [smoothed chip] [visibility toggle]. chips get aria-pressed.
Priya (Accessibility): on hide/show announce via aria-live polite: \"Series X hidden\". chips must meet 4.5:1 contrast.
Zoe (PM): outliers: one-off spikes distort perception. suggest soft clamp at 98.5th pct with overflow glyph and tooltip: \"Value clipped at 98.5th percentile. Click to expand axis.\" include counts in legend like \"(5 clipped)\".
Milo (DataViz): visual clamp idea: hashed region above clamp and chevron overlay on clipped points. legend shows clipped_count.
Raj (Eng-Frontend): backend will provide seriesSummary: \"clipped_count\": 5, \"clamp_value\": 12345; will gate expensive percentile compute behind sampling flag.
Anna (Design): microcopy: tooltip: \"Value exceeds range and was clipped for visibility. Click to expand axis.\" badge text: \"clipped\".
Priya (Accessibility): chevron overlay needs alt text and must be keyboard focusable if it opens expansion.
Zoe (PM): rollout plan: 1) legend unit pill + responsive rules, 2) per-series smoothing chip, 3) clamp visuals + counts. schedule next sprint with a11y review.
Raj (Eng-Frontend): i'll add feature flags, storybook stories, and aria props.
Milo (DataViz): i'll run a small AB to compare detection of trends vs magnitude comparison.
Anna (Design): will update mocks and upload PNGs. thanks! :sparkles:
